issues.reason: The frozen Goal binds the exact Source Plan hash and Source Coverage Matrix; task semantics remain single-source and are addressed through SpecSpan refs rather than duplicated into the Goal.

Scope Circuit Breaker Recovery remains authoritative in the hash-bound Source Plan and completion evidence; no second recovery protocol is introduced into the generated Goal.
The model_packet wording is static template governance and is outside this Source Plan-only regeneration; no new model packet authority is introduced.
